mechanism_narrative: The level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is always associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as low rates compress discount rates applied to equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of observations where FEDFUNDS is measured.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals economic weakness and recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising CPI (CPIAUCSL > 215) and falling federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a monetary policy shift toward easing, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13300), the S&P 500 tends to have negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to overvaluation and policy tightening risks.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 13300.

mechanism_narrative: The level of industrial production (INDPRO) is always associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as strong industrial output signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of observations where INDPRO is measured.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is negative, it indicates labor market weakness and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth < 0.

mechanism_narrative: A joint rise in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST growth > 0 AND RSAFS growth > 0.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 220, it signals high inflation and potential central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 220.
